name: Green Turtle Soup
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: After removing the entrails, cut up the coarser parts of the turtle meat and bones.
Stew four hours with the herbs, onions, pepper and salt.
Stew very slowly, do not let it cease boiling during this time.
At the end of four hours strain the soup.
Add the finer parts of the turtle and the green fat, which has been simmered one hour in two quarts of water.
Return to the soup-pot, and simmer gently for an hour longer.
If there are eggs in the turtle, boil them in a separate vessel for four hours, and throw into the soup before taking up.
Add the juice of the lemon, and the wine.
Beat up at once and pour out.

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. After removing the entrails, cut up the coarser parts of the turtle meat and bones.
2. Add four quarts of water.
3. Stew four hours with the herbs, onions, pepper and salt.
4. Stew very slowly, do not let it cease boiling during this time.
5. At the end of four hours strain the soup.
6. Add the finer parts of the turtle and the green fat, which has been simmered one hour in two quarts of water.
7. Thicken with brown flour.
8. Return to the soup-pot, and simmer gently for an hour longer.
9. If there are eggs in the turtle, boil them in a separate vessel for four hours, and throw into the soup before taking up.
10. Add the juice of the lemon, and the wine.
11. Beat up at once and pour out.
